description: File.read/1 (lib/file.fz read_bytes/read_byte) crosses the extern door once per byte with libc::fgetc and appends each byte with <>, so a 137 KB file costs 137,000 extern calls and quadratic copying. fz-sc8.18 adds one runtime helper, fz_file_read_line(c_pointer) :: any, that reads a line in one call. Fold File.read onto a sibling whole-file read in the same runtime module (or onto the line helper), delete read_bytes/read_byte, keep every File fixture green on all three paths.
title: File.read reads through the line helper instead of one extern call per byte
